preconditions.description: Must be the contract owner to call updateUniswapV2Router function
Contract must hold BNB balance from accumulated fees

exploit_hint: Deploy a malicious router contract with a fallback/receive function that reenters the victim contract. As owner, call updateUniswapV2Router with the malicious router address. The reentrancy occurs when the contract calls the old router during the update process. Reenter through functions like clearStuckBNB() or swapBack() to drain BNB from the contract.
